target_architecture: autonomous self-organizing Xeno fabric with ordinary S1 read-only nodes and dynamically leased coordinator-only S1 writes
execution_surface: clay-direct-dev or owning VPS checkout only
required_sequence: On the owning checkout, do not pull/reset/checkout/mutate yet.

The guard itself resolves current GitHub main through read-only HTTPS git ls-remote and requires local HEAD == remote main, dirty=false, coherent SUPERVISOR_INBOX/FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION authority, HARD_OFF, all provider admissions false, Together forbidden, and exact SHA-256 bindings for critical downstream sources.
If it exits 77, classify STALE_OR_DIRTY_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY and perform no process mutation, restart-authority disable, provider call, secret lookup, or GRID10 promotion action.

Only if the guard PASSes, execute tools/free_swarm_restart_authority_attribution_v4.py read-only and preserve its full receipt. This request does NOT authorize disabling an owning object or killing a process tree.

Return HEAD/tree/dirty, guard receipt SHA-256, restart-attribution receipt SHA-256 if executed, stdout/stderr digests, hostname/machine-id digest/boot-id/PID namespace, and wall-clock timestamps. Never include secret values.

pass_definition.control_sync_guard: PASS only when existing checkout already equals current remote main and is clean and current 9.13 FREE_ONLY/HARD_OFF authority is coherent
pass_definition.restart_attribution: READ_ONLY evidence only; no kill authority is minted by this request

next_if_pass: With a fresh read-only control binding, inspect the root-specific restart-authority-v4 receipt and only under a separately admitted least-privilege mutation step disable the exact owning restart object, revalidate PID/cgroup/entrypoint identity, terminate only the bound Clay legacy tree, and prove >=90 s zero survivors/descendants/restarts.
